author: BourbonBonobo
body:
Applause To The Contributors

   This post is dedicated to all the contributors to the new update

   Wow! So much has changed since I have last spawned into the avicus hub! So much activity has sprung up. So many new staff members have been introduced. So many Maps have been created! I'm really, really proud of the whole avicus community. You guys have really done a great job in making the omega update look so awesome! I have really been missing out huh? I applause the administrators, the moderators, the map dev's, the developers, and the whole avicus community for making this update successful. I'm astonished with the amount of work you guys all put into making the server become even more amazing! I could have never coded, and done this much work if my life depended on it! I'm really happy that I have been a part of the avicus community for this short period of time in my video game history! Now, I don't want to spend too much time applauding, Cheers to everyone! 


  Hope everyone is doing great! Miss you all everyday!



  - SenorSombrero
